segments.title: Gemini now makes the file
segments.say: Gemini can now make the PDF for you, and let you edit it right in the chat.
Upload your messy notes and type:
segments.text: Make this a 1-page PDF study guide.

segments.title: Highlight to fix
segments.say: Then highlight any part, and ask Gemini to change it.

segments.title: Where it works
segments.say: PDFs work on web and mobile. Docs, Sheets and slides are web only.

segments.title: For all Gemini users
segments.say: Google says it's available to all users, wherever the Gemini app is.
Save this for your next study guide, and follow Nexora, the honest referee for AI.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
